clue.text: Unfair gossip?

parts.note: read 'unfair' as the opposite of 'fair' in the sense of good-looking, so the gossip is unattractive talk; it is also the name of Tony Blair's student band

explanation.surface: A complaint that someone is spreading unjust tittle-tattle.
explanation.definitionFit: Hurtful tales that are false are unpleasant hearsay, and 'not fair' read as 'not beautiful' gives the plain-looking word.

clue.text: Strip off a continental quilt, say

parts.note: un is the French word for 'a', so a continental 'a'
a quilt is an example of a bed cover

explanation.surface: Instructions to pull the duvet off the bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Continental quilt' is the old British name for a duvet, which tempts you to read it as one phrase; 'continental' actually goes with 'a'.
explanation.definitionFit: To strip something off is to lay bare what lies beneath, the sense of removing a covering.

clue.text: Ship in river south of the equator

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece placed south of another sits below it, so it comes after

parts.note: sailors call the equator 'the Line', as in crossing the line

explanation.surface: A vessel sailing a river in the southern hemisphere.
explanation.definitionFit: An ocean-going passenger vessel of a shipping company is a type of ship.

clue.text: Hold back the power, or increase it

parts.note: to rein in or rein back a horse is to hold it back
force is power or strength

explanation.surface: A choice between restraining strength and boosting it.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pits holding back against increasing, but 'Hold back' and 'the power' simply join end to end.
explanation.definitionFit: To strengthen something with extra support or numbers is to boost or augment it.

clue.text: Aim at the middle point

definitions.meaning: to aim to do something is to intend it
an average or midpoint between extremes

explanation.definitionFit: To intend something is to have it in mind as a purpose, and an arithmetic average is the central value of a set.

clue.text: Employ completely and beneficially

parts.note: to employ a tool is to use it
fully means completely

explanation.surface: Advice to make the most of something for profit.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting to good purpose, with helpful results, is doing so in a beneficial manner.

clue.text: A charmer about to be detected in depravity

indicators.note: one piece is found sitting inside another, so the second piece contains the first

parts.note: sin is wickedness or depravity
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A seductive person about to be caught in their corrupt ways.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth the Sirens lured sailors with song, so a charming temptress is fairly called by their name.
explanation.definitionFit: A seductive, alluring woman who enchants and lures is a temptress, from the singers of Greek myth.

clue.text: Churchman gets a pass, yet goes astray

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass

indicators.note: the letters of the word yet wander out of their order and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A clergyman is let off, though he still goes wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: An assistant at the altar who serves the priest is a lay church officer.

clue.text: Agree to strike the ball away from leg

parts.note: to hit is to strike
it stands for the ball being struck
in cricket the off side is the half of the field opposite the leg side

explanation.surface: A batsman told to hit the ball to the off side.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the field is split into the leg side and the off side, so the side away from leg is OFF.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people who get on well from the start become friendly, an idiom for being in accord.

clue.text: He stands, wishing to sit

parts.note: one who stands for election hopes to win a seat, as in sitting in Parliament

explanation.surface: A man on his feet longing to take a seat.
explanation.definitionFit: A person standing for office or election hopes to take a seat in the chamber.

clue.text: Money one may charge in Africa

definitions.meaning: an African animal famous for charging

explanation.definitionFit: Old slang for cash, and the horned beast that charges on the African plains.

clue.text: Confirm if the light goes out

indicators.note: the light goes out, around the outside of the other word, enclosing it

parts.note: a Very light is a coloured signal flare fired from a pistol

explanation.surface: A request to check whether the lamp is extinguished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes out' means the light goes outside IF. A Very light is a signal flare named after its inventor.
explanation.definitionFit: To check that something is true or accurate is to establish its truth, the sense of confirming.

clue.text: Amount to be surveyed?

definitions.meaning: a sum, number or volume of something
a ... surveyor measures building materials and costs, so this is what such a person surveys

explanation.definitionFit: A measurable amount or sum, and what a building cost professional estimates and measures.

clue.text: Log that has been cut?

definitions.meaning: a song or disc is cut when it is ..., as in cutting a track

explanation.definitionFit: A written account of events is a log, and a disc of music is said to be cut in the studio.

clue.text: Cows, cats and hens are involved

indicators.note: the letters of these animals are tangled together and rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A list of farmyard creatures, all of them caught up in something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cows' looks like another animal in the list but is the verb meaning to intimidate; 'are involved' rearranges CATS and HENS.
explanation.definitionFit: To subdue or humble someone by discipline is to intimidate them into meekness.

clue.text: Jack may have a flutter, given this

definitions.text: Jack may have a flutter, given this

parts.words: Jack may have a flutter, given this
parts.note: a jack is a ship's flag, which flutters when hoisted on a pole, rather than a man named Jack placing a small bet

explanation.surface: A man named Jack might place a small bet if offered this.
explanation.definitionFit: The tall pole on which a flag such as the Union Jack is hoisted to wave in the wind.

clue.text: Eric got me confused just using simple figures

indicators.note: the letters of these three words are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Eric muddled me by sticking to basic sums.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confused' rearranges ERIC GOT ME; 'figures' suggests numbers but here means shapes.
explanation.definitionFit: A design made only of plain shapes such as lines, circles and squares is in that style.

clue.text: Marsh has a meeting put into the paper

indicators.note: one piece is inserted into the middle of the other

parts.note: a quire is a measure of paper, 24 or 25 sheets
an AGM is an annual general meeting

explanation.surface: A report of a swamp gathering appearing in a newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: A QUIRE is a set of sheets of paper; AGM (annual general meeting) goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft, boggy area of land that gives underfoot is a bog or swamp.

clue.text: Our haste ruined the distribution

indicators.note: the letters of these two words are wrecked and rebuilt in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Being in a hurry spoiled how things were handed out.
explanation.definitionFit: A dividing up of goods or money among people is an allocation of portions.

clue.text: It's used for making chips

parts.note: the chips are microchips in electronics, not fried potatoes

explanation.surface: Something you need in a fryer or chip shop.
explanation.definitionFit: The semiconductor element from which microprocessors and computer circuits are made.

clue.text: Careful opening bid for a chest

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a bid is an offer at an auction

explanation.surface: A cautious starting price put on a chest at auction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'opening' looks like it describes the bid, but it takes the first letter of 'Careful'.
explanation.definitionFit: A strongbox for keeping money or valuables is a type of chest.

clue.text: Draws a famous Singapore hotel

definitions.meaning: lotteries for prizes, in which tickets are drawn
the colonial hotel in Singapore named after Sir Stamford ..., home of the Singapore Sling

explanation.definitionFit: Prize lotteries drawn from tickets, and the grand colonial hotel in Singapore named after its founder.

clue.text: Head initially greatly put out by state of apathy

indicators.note: the letters are put out of their order and rearranged
only the first letter of the word Head is taken

explanation.surface: The boss was rather annoyed by an apathetic mood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes H from 'Head'; 'put out' rearranges H with GREATLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Sluggish weariness and lack of energy or interest is a condition of listlessness.

clue.text: No right to declare an item of property

indicators.note: the following letter is not there, so it is taken away

parts.note: to assert is to declare or state firmly

explanation.surface: Someone has no entitlement to list a possession.
explanation.definitionFit: A possession of value owned by a person or company counts among their holdings.

clue.text: End of investment that helps the poor

definitions.meaning: investment is an old word for a siege
poor ... was public aid to the needy

explanation.definitionFit: The raising of a siege ends it, and the old system of aid to the needy was so called.

clue.text: I take on short employment on a holiday island

parts.note: biz is a shortened form of business, one's employment

explanation.surface: Someone taking a brief job at a resort.
explanation.definitionFit: A Balearic island in the Mediterranean that is a famous resort for tourists and clubbers.

clue.text: Heroic film showing in some picture-houses

indicators.note: the film is showing inside these words, its letters running across them

explanation.surface: A grand film on release in a handful of cinemas.
explanation.definitionFit: A grand film on a vast scale about legendary heroes is called by the name of long narrative poems.

clue.text: Figures it's only one among hundreds

indicators.note: one piece sits among, that is inside, the other

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so CS for hundreds
taken as written

explanation.surface: A claim that something is a lone item among many hundreds.
explanation.walkthrough: C is the Roman numeral for 100; 'among' puts ONE inside CS.
explanation.definitionFit: Solid geometric shapes with a circular base tapering to a point are figures in geometry.

clue.text: Just not taking sides

explanation.definitionFit: Fair-minded and even-handed, and neutral in a dispute without bias to either party.

clue.text: They protected front-line troops from various technocrats

indicators.note: the letters of the word technocrats are rearranged into a varied new order

explanation.surface: Different experts kept the soldiers in the front line safe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'various' rearranges TECHNOCRATS; the coats were worn in the trenches of the First World War.
explanation.definitionFit: Waterproof belted coats were first designed for officers serving in the First World War trenches.
